name: smx-spectro
comment: Passive spectroscopy: dense per-5-tick state dumps on UNFED knots -> offline FFT of quanta/heat time series finds the structures' natural oscillation modes before we choose drive periods. 4 different seeds so the spectrum is surveyed across knot sizes. 128^3 fits hopfion_32_8's 81x80x17 extent with ~16-cell margin clearance (v2 showed this seed's halo survives at clr9).
